notes.title: FREESTYLE AREA in da workz! Update live now
notes.content:
Lovely players! We are working on a FREESTYLE AREA and have placed some quirky jumps (including a LOOP) after the BIG JUMP for ya all. Will add more jumps/slopes/funky stuffs shortly + portals, so it's easy to get there + repeat the FREESTYLING. We will add points for jumps&tricks when FREESTYLE AREA is DONE DONE. Let us know WHAT YA THINK. Remember that you can cheat your way to the BIG JUMP by hitting the key R on your keyboard. We will work on an in-game cheater-fixer, so you don't have to leave VR.
